claims.text: The supplied eligible-evidence list is empty.
The absence of eligible evidence prevents identification of specific phase-transformation pathways for Mg–transition-metal alloys in the 800–1000 °C window.
The absence of eligible evidence prevents identification of volatility thresholds and sintering limitations for Mg–transition-metal alloys in the 800–1000 °C window.
Specific Mg–transition-metal phase-diagram, sintering-kinetics, and elemental-volatility data are required to define a viable processing window.
Mg, Zn, and Mn are examples of elements whose volatility may be relevant to defining the sintering window.
A falsification experiment cannot be designed without baseline data on density and volatility limits.
